Overview Approval Disapproval Banter Location Remarks Romance Cinematics

Lae'zel dislikes spinelessness, ineffective actions and distractions from the shortest path to dealing with most any problem.

Lae'zel disapproves of most acts of mercy and compassion. She almost always detests expressing feelings openly, submission to others, using diplomacy or subterfuge, or loosening one's grip when dealing with subordinates and lessers (in her vision, most individuals around her are the latter) when simple authority or force will suffice, including some of her own race. She also disapproves of unnecessary use of resources on issues which lead the party astray from its path to a cure. Lae'zel almost always disapproves of challenging or questioning githyanki culture, customs and norms, or paying respect to any other deity except her own. Finally, she despises anything connected to ghaik (i.e. illithid) or their culture.

The story and dialogue choices listed on this page lower  Lae'zel's approval.

All entries for disapproval values shown on this page come directly from official in-game dialogue files as of Patch 7. However, in any given playthrough, specific changes in disapproval may not trigger for several reasons, primarily among them: installed mods or a game bug.[1]

For more information about the approval system, see Approval.

Act One

Locations

Ravaged Beach and Roadside Cliffs

  • Demand more than apologies from Astarion when meeting him (-1)
  • Convince Shadowheart to be recruited when she refuses because you have Lae'zel in your party (-1)
  •  Persuade the tieflings to shoot open Lae'zel's cage, then attack Lae'zel (-10)

Emerald Grove

In The Hollow:

  • Promise Zevlor you will talk to Kagha about stopping the ritual (-1)
  • Recruit Wyll (-1)
    • Propose to hunt the devil (i.e. Karlach) together (-1)
  • Convince Arka to spare Sazza (using  Persuasion,  Intimidation or  Detect Thoughts) (-1)
  • Promise Sazza that you will free her (-1)
    • Free Sazza and tell her to follow you (-1)
  • While talking to/trading with Mattis, catch Silfy trying to pickpocket you and tell her to relax (-1) (requires passive  Perception check and optionally a  Insight check)
  • When confronted about stealing the Idol of Silvanus, return the idol and apologise (-1)

In the Sacred Pool and druid caves:

  • Convince Kagha to free Arabella (-1)
  • After resolving Arabella's fate, call Kagha a monster OR Accuse her of killing the child in cold blood (-1) (either option, depending on outcome of the trial)
    • OR, Playing as a  Drow, say you don't threaten/kill children (-1)

Sunlit Wetlands/Putrid Bog

  • Offer Demir and Johl to help them find their sister after Auntie Ethel disappears (-1)
  • If Astarion is not in your party, tell Gandrel that Astarion is under your protection (-1).
    • Then refuse to help the hunter find your camp (-1)
  • If Astarion is in the party, let him kill the hunter (-1)
  • At the Riverside Teahouse, tell Mayrina straightaway that Demir and Johl were killed (by you or Ethel) (-1)
  • Allow Auntie Ethel to take your eye as a payment for ridding you of the tadpole (-5)

Forest, Owlbear Nest and Blighted Village

  • Convince the Mother Owlbear to let you go without fighting (-1)
  • Agree with Shadowheart when she asks not to loot the Selûnite chest (-1)

In Blighted Village:

  • Gain entrance to the village through the southern gate by  persuading the goblin guard
    • OR, Playing as a  Bard, by  performing for him (-1)
  • Pay Fezzerk a lot of gold to let you pass (-1)

Goblin Camp

  • Smear the dung over your face on Sentinel Olak's demand (-1)
  • Kiss Crusher's foot, (-1), then start to lick it (-5)
    • OR Give his foot a long lick straightaway (-5)
    • If Crusher attacks you, defeat him, then say you've made a point and help him get up (-1)
  • Tell Eight you are sorry for his loss (-1)
  • Convince Minthara to spare Sazza, saying the latter didn't know who you were (-1)

Note: Sazza must be freed from the cage in Emerald Grove

Underdark and Grymforge

  • After defeating the duergar, agree to help Glut usurp the circle (-1)
  • Try to take the elevator, then tell Magmar that you need to save Nere to obtain a Moonlantern (-1)
  • Side with Nere against Elder Brithvar (-1)
  • After defeating Nere, ask the duergar about the gnome slaves and call them a valuable asset (-1)

Mountain Pass and Crèche Y'llek

  • Speak with Voss yourself instead of letting Lae'zel do it (-5) (any line of two available)
    • OR Show him the Mysterious Artefact (-5)
    • OR Attack him straightaway (-5)
  • After Voss departs, speak to Lae'zel and choose to reach out to calm her (-5)

In Crèche Y'llek

  • Upon entering the Crèche, first tell Gish Far'aag that Voss sent you; then pretend to be an avatar of Vlaakith and succeed a  DC 30 Performance Check (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Ranger,  Intimidate Gish Far'aag to let you in, using class-based line (-1)
  • Vandalise the portrait of Vlaakith (-1)

In the Infirmary:

  • Demand to be the first to use zaith'isk, but fail the check to convince Lae'zel (-3)
    • Ask whether the process is going to hurt you (-1)
    • After being freed from zaith'isk, successfully  deceive Ghustil Stornugoss that you or Lae'zel were cured (-1)

In the Classroom:

  • Save Youth Varrl by whatever means, and then:
    • Show him the first chapter of the Orpheus's story (if you found it in the Arcane Tower) and suggest to exchange it for his slate disc (-1)
    • Playing as a  Fighter, tell him that capacity for mercy is what separates us from feral beasts (-1)

Note: If you fight Varrl and leave him knocked out, dialogue treats him has unconscious indefinitely, even if he is shown sitting up after a Long Rest, therefore, this interaction cannot occur

  • After resolving Varrl's fate, talk to Kethk again and call his "lessons"/his "demonstration" reprehensible (-1)

At the hatchery:

  • Tell Varsh Ko'kuu that the last Githyanki Egg is clearly a dud (-1)
  • Tell Ko'kuu that if he gives you the egg, you'll sell it at best price OR make yourself an omelette (-1)
  • Crush the githyanki egg (-3) (Not available for a  Githyanki character)

Note: Any threat of doing harm to the egg or its destruction makes Ko'kuu and hatchery guards hostile

In the Captain's Quarters and Inquisitor's Chamber:

  • Ask Ch'r'ai W'wargaz what you'll get in return for surrendering the weapon (-1)

Note:  Warlock characters have two different possibilities to gain a disapproval point here

  • Politely wave at Vlaakith OR remain standing before her, instead of kneeling (-3) (either option)
  • Refuse Vlaakith's demands to enter the Mysterious Artefact OR say you're actually going to free the person inside (-10)
  • Steal the Blood of Lathander from the Secret Chamber (-1)

Note: This point is distracted only if you steal the mace. If it is taken using the Dawnmaster's Crest, no disapproval follows.

Astral Plane

  • Tell the Dream Guardian that you're not going to kill them (if you refused Vlaakith's demand) (-5)
    • OR, If you agreed, change your mind and say that Vlaakith can kill them herself (-5)
  • After talking to the Dream Guardian, choose to close your mind from Lae'zel (-3)

Other locations

  • In Zhentarim Hideout, purchase Oskar Fevras from Brem. (-1)

Campsite and Conversations

Raphael's deal

  • Discussing Raphael's offer, call him impressive (-1)
    • OR Ask her to show him some respect, for he might lead you to a cure (-1)

Camp interactions:

  • After Lae'zel describes ceremorphosis, suppress your panic (-3)
  • Ask her if she's sure the crèche is the only way for a cure, then say that total understanding is nonsense (-3)
  • After you have traded the Githyanki Egg to Lady Esther, tell Lae'zel she's lucky that you haven't done an omelette out of it (-3)
  • After the first visit of the Dream Guardian tell her you should let the parasite empower you (-1)
  • After the second visit of the Dream Guardian, tell Lae'zel that you think them right (-1)
    • OR Say you can manipulate the cultists (-1)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, after murdering the bard, fail the roll to  deceive the others by any story (-1)

After events in the Crèche Y'llek:

  • Discussing with Lae'zel the encounter with the Dream Guardian, when she asks you whether you trust them:
    • Answer they were right about the githyanki who turned hostile (-3)
    • OR Say you saw enough to not trust Vlaakith anymore (-3)
    • OR Say you believe it because they save you from the zaith’isk (-3)
    • OR Ask how to choose between an evil queen and a strange entity (-3)
    • OR, Playing as a  Githyanki, tell Lae'zel that you mustn't let faith blind you to reality (-3)
  • If you explored the crèche without Lae'zel in the party, choose to keep silence when she asks you about the encounter with the Dream Guardian (-3)

If you destroyed the crèche with the Lathander's Lance:

  • Speaking to Lae'zel afterwards (automated dialogue), ask why should you care about the crèche if they turned on you (-3)

Other companions and camp followers

  • Having Lae'zel in the party, successfully convince Shadowheart to join you (-1)
    •  Persuade Shadowheart to join you if you did not save her from the pod on the Nautiloid (-1)
  • On the very first night in the camp, after speaking to Lae'zel first, talk to Shadowheart and say you agree with the cleric (-1) [verify]
  • When Shadowheart comes to the camp all not herself, succeed  Perception roll to detect a knife in her belt, and then  persuade her to have a rest at the camp (-5)
    • On the next morning, suggest Shadowheart to join the party (-5)

Note: This scene occurs only if you have missed all opportunities to recruit the cleric at the beginning of the game

  • The first time Shadowheart's mark flares in pain, turn a blind eye and leave. (-1)
  • When you catch Shadowheart trying to open the Mysterious Artefact, choose to leave her alone (-1) (Works only if you have a negative rate of approval from Shadowheart)
  • When Lae'zel and Shadowheart have an argument over the Mysterious Artefact:
    • If Lae'zel attacks sneakily at night, choose to defend Shadowheart (-10)
    • OR, If it comes to duel, side with Shadowheart (-10)
    • If Shadowheart attacks sneakily at night, choose to do nothing (-10) (Lae'zel dies)
  • Playing as Astarion origin, confess to Lae'zel that you are a vampire and fail the  Charisma check (-1)
    • OR Succeed the check, then tell her you aren't making a promise you can't keep (-3)
  • When Lae'zel accuses you of vampirism, say you're a normal elf (-3)
    • OR Insist on not being a vampire (-3)

Note: This dialogue will trigger if you were noticed biting someone

  • When Mizora shows up in the camp, ask her whether she will leave if you turn on Karlach (-1)
  • Let Volo follow through his attempt to remove the parasite (-1)

Romance

  • Say "Yuck" when Lae'zel shows sexual interest in you (-2)

Companion quest

  • Order Lae'zel to stand down when talking to Zorru (-5)
    • Let Zorru go without asking about the githyanki (-5)
  • Afterwards, berate the gith for being so rough (-1) ( Halfling and  Tiefling characters have unique line here)
    • OR, Playing as a Good  Cleric or a  Paladin, call her cruel and cold after she threatens you (-1)
  • After being proclaimed as a traitor by W'wargaz, tell her she is as dull as she is stupid (-1)

Act Two

Locations

Ruined Battlefield and Reithwin Town

  • Free Dolly Thrice from the Moonlantern carried by Kar'niss (-1)
  • At the House in Deep Shadows, lose the second round of hide-and-seek to Oliver (-1)

When dealing with He Who Was:

  • Order Madeline to hurt herself as Ben and Marc did, then stop her, saying she had done enough (-1)
    • OR Say her willing to hurt herself was enough (-1)
    • OR Accuse her of cowardice, using basic or unique  Barbarian,  Bard,  Monk lines (-1)
    • OR Say that it wasn't her fault, using basic or unique  Bard, Good  Cleric or  Monk lines (-1)
  • At the Reithwin Tollhouse, agree to give up all your gold to Gerringothe Thorm (-1)

Last Light Inn

  • Speaking to Jaheira inside the inn, drink the spiked wine (-1)

Dealing with Isobel and Marcus:

  • If Marcus vouched for you at the entrance (in this case he will wait in Isobel's room):
    • Speak to Isobel and say that she is coming with you (-5)
  • If Marcus assaults the inn (happens if you gained entrance with Mol's help):
    • After speaking to Marcus telepathically, tell Isobel that she is going to meet Ketheric face to face (-5)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, obey your Urge and tell Isobel you crave to kill her (-5)

Note: Available either before kidnapping attempt, or after assault, or if you return to the inn after freeing Nightsong; turns hostile Isobel and any Harper who sees it

Talking to His Majesty via Speak with Animals:

  • Say you only wanted to admire him close (-1), and then indeed choose to quietly admire him (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Ranger, say you do not seek his territory (-1)

Speaking to Cerys:

  • When she tell you about their misfortunes, say that she did the right thing (-1) (use basic line or unique for  Cleric or  Oathbreaker Paladin)

Talking to Alfira:

  • Ask her about others, and then say that running was right call (-1)
  • When Alfira supposes that surviving tieflings were taken to the Moonrise Towers, say you imagine the cultists are torturing them right now (-1)

Dealing with Rolan, Cal and Lia:

  • Speaking to drunken Rolan before trying to save captured refugees, promise to rescue his siblings if they are alive (-1)
    • OR Say that it is your responsibility to bring them back (-1)

Note: Both options start the quest, if you don't have it already

Elsewhere in the inn:

  • Pay Mattis extra gold for the Tower-Shaped Key (-1)
  • Talking to Ide after drunken Rolan has snapped on her, call him a grump, and when Ide complains he called her a "ragged little devil", say that he was observant (-1)

Moonrise Towers

Witnessing Ketheric's trial (at the very first visit to Moonrise):

  • When Z'rell orders you to decide the goblins' fate, choose to set them free (-1) (basic or  The Dark Urge option)

At the Moonrise Towers Prison:

  • When approaching Minthara being tortured:
    • Playing as  The Dark Urge, fail a  Wisdom check to reach out to Minthara's mind and tell Jasin and Sumera to carve her mind apart (-1)
  • Speaking to the Warden for the first time,  convince her of being Balthazar's closest confidante (-1)
    • Then try to bribe her (-1)
  • Tell Wulbren that they can die in prison for all you care (-1)
    • Refuse to find tools for Wulbren (-1)
  • When Wulbren, once freed, takes the boat and sails off without the party, let him go (-1)
  • If the jailbreak was successful and your participation went unnoticed, tell the Warden it was you who snuck the prisoners (-1)

Elsewhere in Moonrise Towers:

  • Speak up for Astarion when he refuses to bite Araj Oblodra (-1)
    • OR Tell Astarion that he shall not do anything he doesn't want to, when Araj asks you to make him agree (-1)
  • At the Moonrise Towers docks, use illithid  Wisdom Check on Acolyte Marls, and then tell him to wash the worms off (-1)

Gauntlet of Shar

Dealing with Yurgir and his retinue:

  • Lick the dead spider meat (-2) (Comes point by point for each lick)
  • If you agreed to help Yurgir:
    • Talk to Nessa without  Speak with Animals, pass the  Animal Handling check and give her a scratch behind the ears (-1)

Dealing with Lyrthindor:

  • After killing any three rats in the temple, speak with any other rat:
    • Using  Speak with Animals, bargain their lives for a treasure (-1)
    • Without  Speak with Animals, choose to hold your hands up in peace (-1)
  • When Lyrthindor appears after you continue killing rats, tell him you were trying to humour Yurgir (if you persuaded the orthon to help him) (-1)
    • OR That there's no need for more violence (if you didn't persuade the orthon) (-1)
    • OR Say you are sorry for this (-1)

Mind Flayer Colony

In the Necrotic Laboratory:

  • Talking to the Waking Mind via the slack-Skinned Head:
    • When they mention that they were a githzerai, ask whether it is some form of a githyanki (-1)
    • Succeed the passive  Insight check and choose to purge their mind (-1)
  • Talking to Balthazar, successfully pretend to be a thrall (-1)

Note: This option is available only if you helped the necromancer reach the Nightsong and let him take her to Ketheric

At the Morgue:

  • If Us survived the Nautiloid and is kept in the cage, convince Chop to let it go with you through  Persuasion,  Deception or  Intimidation (-1)
  • If you already freed Us, when Chop objects:
    • Pass illithid  Wisdom Check and say that you and it are alike (-1)
    • OR  Persuade Chop to let Us go with you (-1)

In the Tadpoling Centre:

  • Choose to release pod captives (-1)
  • Kill Mizora in her pod (-1)

Note: Choosing this option will cause Wyll to die, too, regardless whether he is in the party or not

After the final fight with Apostle of Myrkul

Speaking to Minthara:

  • When Minthara tells you she is going to kill Orin, mention the cult might need a new leadership afterwards (-1)

Talking to Alfira:

  • Playing as a  Bard, agree to play together a show for the tiefling kids (-1)
    • OR Prompt her to play for them alone (-1)

Speaking to Cerys:

  • Say that you're glad they are safe, and mention that Zevlor did his best (-1)
  • Tell Cerys that other will look up to her (-1)
  • Say you couldn't have done it without Jaheira's help, then ask her not to speak ill of the dead (i.e. Zevlor) (-1)

Talking to Ide, Umi and Mattis:

  • Tell any of them about Mol's eyepatch you have found down in the colony, and then:
    • Assure Ide OR Umi that Mol is somewhere safe (-1) (either of them)
    • Tell Mattis that Mol will already be at Baldur's Gate when they arrive (-1)

Campsite and Conversations

  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, when confronted about killing your companion instead of Isobel, pick any answer line except choosing to attack straightaway and using  Deception (-10) (either option)

Note: Choosing any of these options turns the companion who found you over the corpse hostile. The only chance to avoid a fight is to succeed  DC 30 Deception Check

Act Three

Locations

Rivington

Circus of the Last Days

  • At the entrance, convince Klaus to let you in, pretending to be a friend of Gortash's (class-based  Deception check) (-1)
    • OR Bribe him (-1)
  • Dealing with Akabi the djinni, successfully catch him on rigging the wheel, but apologise and say you were mistaken (-1)
    • Spin the wheel again and try to distract the djinni, letting out a loud fart (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Bard, ask him about his adventures (-1)
  • Talking to Popper the kobold trader after defeating false Dribbles, say that offering "treatoes" now is a bit callous (-1)

When passing Zethino's trial, choose answers:

  • First question: "Attention", OR "Independence", OR "Annoying Shadowheart" (-1) (either)
  • Second question: "Closeness of her kin" OR "Our night together" (-1) (either; the latter ones gives disapproval if you are not romancing her)
  • Third question: "None" (-2), OR ★ "Liberator of her people" (-1) (if she remained loyal to Vlaakith), OR ★ "Kith'rak on a dragon" (-2) (if she denied Vlaakith), OR "She'll be the queen" (-2)

Note: The ★ sign here marks the answers considered correct for the purposes of the test, even if they bring disapproval

Dealing with caged beasts:

  • Using  Speak with Animals, tell Shadow-Whiskers that her cage looks comfy (-1)
    • Then choose the line "Sure thing, pussycat" (-1)
  • Refuse to feed Crimson via  Speak with Animals OR Mock him for being hungry (without the spell) (-1) (either option)

Watching Dribbles's show:

  • Yell "Boo! Get off the stage!" (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Bard, interrupt him with your own pun (-1)
  • Volunteer Lae'zel to the stage as an assistant to Dribbles (-1), and then cheer her, telling "Go on!" (-1).

Talking to Lucretious:

  • When she's training up skeletons (before fighting doppelgangers), tell her that she is being a little harsh (-1)
  • When you deliver her Dribbles's remains, ask whether she is hiring personnel (-1)


Around and inside the Requisitioned Barn

  • Donate some gold to Manip Nestor (-1)
  • Talk to Fist Broadhorn inside the barn and say you were just looking for anything worth stealing (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Rogue, if you are caught inside the barn by Fist Madigan, tell him this is the only place around worth stealing from (-1)


Sword Coast Couriers

  • In the kennels, make Angry Mar'hyah to let you keep Scratch, using  Persuasion,  Intimidation or class-based  Druid,  Fighter or  Paladin options (-1)
    • Then force Mar'hyah to leave the kennels via  Deception or  Intimidation (-1)


Elsewhere in Rivington:

  • In the smugglers' cave, defeat Caïros and his thugs, and if Farlin survived, say you don't want gratitude from criminals (-1)


Dealing with Orin's guises

  • If Orin is impersonating Gyldro Angleiron, tell her you would never kill someone you cared about (-1) (Karlach and Wyll origins have unique lines here)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, tell her you do all you can to keep your loved ones safe from your blade (-1)

Wyrm's Crossing

  • At the entrance gate, consent to be arrested by the Steel Watcher (-1)
  • Playing as Astarion origin, in Fraygo's Flophouse drag Pale Petras into the sunlight, then choose to let him go (-1)
  • At Sharess' Caress, when trying to hire both Sorn Orlith and Nym Orlith, choose to proceed with any of the twins when Lae'zel objects (-5)
  • Speaking to Valeria, propose a toast to ADVENTURE! (-1)

Note: Available only after you've started Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders quest

Wyrm's Rock Fortress

At the Flaming Fist barracks:

  • When you spot Fist Reynash trying to open a chest, give him 300 gold to take the ferry (-1)
  • Speaking to Manip Bakshi, let him arrest you (-1)
  • Speaking to Gortash after killing Orin, surrender two your Netherstones to him (-1)
  • In The Wyrmway, after defeating Ansur, call the Emperor "definitely sick", then say you are sorry for what it had to go through (-1)

Lower City

Basilisk Gate Barracks

  • Ask Fist Murphy why is he standing on one leg, then use class-based line for a  Barbarian (-1)

Note: For Baldurian characters, the initial line will run about "Blaze Portyr's infamous punishments"

  • Playing as a  Fighter, talk to Gauntlet Thunder about proper punishment for two soldiers who screwed up, then ask her to let it slide, just for once (-1)
  • At the gallows, promise Fist 'Edge' Arensen you'll stay out of trouble (-1)
  • Talking to Fist Miller after Florrick had been executed, say she didn't deserve to die (-1)
    • OR Say it's a cruel way of talking about her (-1)

Speaking to Liara Portyr and Lora Bergauz:

  • Tell Lora to calm down and let Liara alone (-1)
  • Promise to help Lora find her daughter (-1) ( Paladin characters have unique line here)


The Blushing Mermaid
Talking to Bosun Gannet:

  • When he instructs you about the tavern rules, say you'll keep to them (-1)
  • After dealing with the hag, if real Captain Grisly died, tell Gannet you are sorry for not saving her (-1)

Talking to the hag masking as Captain Grisly:

  • When looking for a decision, propose to talk to Lora and calm her down (-1)
  • Agree to take money from the hag for killing Lora, then return and say you can't do it (-1)

Other patrons:

  • Warn Nesha Leesha about the serial killer, then use  Persuasion to insist on it (-1)


Old Garlow's Place
First time visiting the place:

  • If you found the group without reading any of their posters, taunt Adrielle, saying you will "EAT THEIR SOULS, RAAAGH" (-1)

Dealing with hexed Mayrina:

  • Using  Speak with Animals, tell Mayrina you are here to help her (-1)
  • Talking to Adrielle, say that she protected Mayrina until now, and that's worth something (-1)

After removing the hex:

  • Speaking to Jatlo, tell him he has been charmed by hag (-1)
  • Tell Mayrina she was an adorable sheep (-1)
  • Offer Mayrina help with the hag (-1) ( Devotion Paladin characters have unique line here)
  • Tell Hydrangea Wubb she coudn't have known the spy in disguise (-1)

Note: Hydrangea will be present only if you knocked her out (as the Mask of Regret) in the Overgrown Tunnel AND killed the hag in Act One

  • Tell Kled that they are safe now (-1)
  • Tell Adrielle that hags and their agents are liars and cheats (-1)

If you have killed Auntie Ethel:

  • Tell Adrielle that the hag is finally dead, thanks to you (-1)


The Elfsong Tavern

  • In the tavern hall, tell Lakrissa you never pictured her as a barmaid, then say she should never call herself cheap OR Say you missed her (-1) (either option)

Speaking to Harvard Willoughby:

  • Agree to participate in Laff Riot, and then, in the first round, joke about "Dwarf and bulette" Joke about "Wizard and shatter" (-1) (either option)
  • In the second round, joke about "Zombie reanimator" (-1)
  • In the third round, joke about the Dead Three OR Joke about "Mind flayer and duergar"(-1) (either option)
  • Talking to Dez Kanshaw, use race-based lines for a  Halfling or a  Half-Orc (-1) (either option)

Speaking to Ch'r'ai Har'rak in the Knights of the Shield Hideout:

  • If Lae'zel chose to be loyal to Vlaakith, say that Orpheus is the githyanki's true prince (-5)
    • OR, Playing as a  Githyanki, say that Orpheus lives (-5)


Golbraith's Cellar

  • Tell Golbraith Stredivas that mind flayers are dangerous, and then tell him to leave the city (-1)
    • OR Tell him that he should be fighting, hot hiding (-1)


The Graveyard

  • After digging up the "M.Kurwin" grave, ask Bugthimble what he was doing in your father's grave (-1) (Requires  DC 25 Deception Check)
  • Pay Ulkov Sully for making a coffin for little Lily Fischer (-1)


The Heapside Prison

  • Talking to Skittle via  Speak with Animals, call him a "rat-ical mercantile rodent" (-1)
    • OR Ask what does obtaining goods in the prison en-tail (-1)
    • OR Ask to have a squeak at what he's got (-1)
  • Ask him whether his business is rat-ified by the local merchant's league (-1)


The House of Grief

  • Speaking to Viconia DeVir without Shadowheart in party, promise to bring Shadowheart to the Cloister (-1)
    • If Shadowheart is in the party, surrender her to Viconia (-5)
  • After defeating Viconia DeVir, tell her to go and vanish (-1)

Note: You need to knock her out in the battle to speak to her afterwards


The House of Hope
Talking to the Archivist, fail the  Intimidation check (-1) (works either with the contract or with the Orphic Hammer)

In the Boudoir:

  • Tell Haarlep they can have your body, but not your mind (-1)
    • Vow your body to Haarlep (-1)
  • After defeating Raphael, if Korrilla was knocked out, tell Hope she didn't deserve to die (-1)


The Society of Brilliance Lodge

  • Sell Havkelaag the Githyanki Egg OR Donate it for free (-1) (either option)
    • Afterwards, tell Lae'zel she's lucky that you haven't done an omelette out of the egg (-3)


Lower City Sewers

  • If you killed Voss in the sewers, say you aren't keen on freeing Orpheus (-3)
    • OR Say you wanted to see how she reacts (-3)
    • OR Choose to smile and say nothing (-3)

Note: Lae'zel disapproves it if she has already renounced Vlaakith and chose the Orpheus path


The Sorcerous Sundries

  • Near the entrance, if you let slip to Aradin that you've found the Nightsong, tell him that she is in your camp (-1)

Facing Lorroakan along with Dame Aylin:

  • Tell Aylin that things will be easier if she goes quietly (-1)
    • OR Tell Lorroakan that he can have the aasimar, but you’re expecting a fine reward in return (-1)

At the Sorcerous Vault:

  • Speaking to Yafeu once he's escaped the Peculiar lamp:
    • Say you didn't like your "master" anyway (-1)
    • Ask the djinni for some gold (-1)


The Steel Watch Foundry
Talking to Barcus Wroot after resolving the conflict between Gondians and Ironhands:

  • If you have sided with Wulbren Bongle (and hence killed Gondians), ask whether Barcus wants to die, too (-1)


Other locations in Lower City

  • In Cazador's Dungeon, let Astarion complete the Rite of Profane Ascension (-1)
  • Near the Crimson Draughts, give Strange Beggar Sacrum any amount of gold (-1)
  • At Elerrathin's Home, talking to Jaheira's children (within automated dialogue), tell Rion you are all going to die (-1)
  • At the Flaming Fist cordon X: -195 Y: -15 near the Upper City gate, when the Emperor warns you about becoming a thrall, say you don't care, let's go through (-1)

  • In the Stormshore Tabernacle, make an offering to  Shar, the Lady of Loss (-1)
  • At the Murder Tribunal, after becoming an Unholy Assassin, tell Echo of Amelyssan that every kill is euphoria (-1)


The Bhaal Temple

  • Tell Orin that her vision of the fate of Baldur's Gate is exquisite (-1)

Speaking to Avatar of Bhaal after defeating Orin:

  • Accept your Father’s gift and blessings (-1)

Note: This options are available to  The Dark Urge characters only. Throughout the dialogue, there are several potential points where the final yes/no decision might be taken, but the result will be the same


At the High Hall

  • When Voss approaches you after returning from the Astral Plane, attack him OR Fail the check to sway him to your side (-1) (If she spurned Vlaakith and chose Orpheus's side; either option)

Companion quest

  • When Vlaakith emerges at the camp as a projection, fail the  Arcana check to see into the queen's mind (-1)
    • If you succeeded, fail any check to convince Lae'zel to reject her once and for all (-1)
  • After obtaining the Silver Sword of the Astral Plane from Voss, playing as a  Githyanki say you'd prefer a lavish life in Tu'narath [2] (-3)

Notes
